scope: Free official Windows backend candidates; evidence collection and eligibility assessment, not product integration or release
user_constraints: permanent free use without long-term usage constraints
daily app use with minimal interaction
Linux-equivalent application and descendant network containment

sandboxie.runtime_observation_scope: Windows Server 2025, ordinary user, signed driver
observed_strengths: Parent and real-child HTTP/SOCKS succeeded in earlier and latest follow-up runs.
Direct TCP denied; proxy stop did not restore direct TCP.
Unconnected loopback UDP4/UDP6 rejected in both boxes with outside positive controls.
Ordinary-user persistent-service exact-port policy update read back correctly.
unresolved: One intermediate DNS-IPC parent proxy failure not reproduced; original error unavailable.
Visible GUI and profile persistence not verified on native Windows 11.
Simple final product installer and daily launcher integration not accepted.
exclusion_evidence: Free Start launch path has source-observed aged-install support reminders.
Plus commercial use has a business-certificate restriction.
Official Free Classic replacement also has support reminders and lists no free WFP support.

proxybridge.runtime_observation_scope: Windows Server 2025, ordinary user, signed driver
observed_strengths: Parent and same-image child completed explicit HTTP/SOCKS probes to the bypassed local Mihomo port. This is not independent evidence of transparent application TCP redirection.
Ordinary user controlled stock service without per-launch elevation.
disqualifying_observations: Selected parent and child loopback UDP4/UDP6 reached the fixed receivers, twice.
Selected UDP still reached the fixed receivers after owned Mihomo stopped.
source_scope_gaps: Stock rules match socket-owner process image/path; general different-executable descendants are not automatically inherited.
No independent persistent deny boundary when interception stops.
limits: Server UDP evidence is not a completed Windows 11 wire experiment.
Public IPv6 outside control had no route.
TCP connect alone was not counted as a direct leak; fixed direct receiver delta was zero.
This does not prove a future patched implementation cannot work.

native_windows_11.cancellation_reason: Requirements already disqualify stock candidates; avoid further long native experiments.
native_windows_11.scope: Both native jobs confirmed cancelled; requirements-based cancellation is neither Windows 11 pass nor framework failure.

next_step: The bounded ProxyBridge local-repair attempt stopped at the identity and persistent failure-blocking gate; discuss a different Windows backend design before further implementation or long CI runs.
